articles.title: Scouting America drops jamboree diversity initiatives after Pentagon pressure
bullets: Scouting America removed dedicated spaces for LGBTQ+ youth, girls and scouts of color at the National Jamboree.
The event in West Virginia ends Friday and drew about 15,000 scouts, leaders and volunteers.
Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth had threatened to end the Pentagon’s long-running support unless the group pulled back diversity efforts.

articles.title: First responders testify in Lindsay Clancy triple-murder trial
bullets: Police and firefighters described finding Lindsay Clancy outside her Massachusetts home after she jumped from a window.
Jurors heard accounts of the moment officers found her three children dead in the basement.
The trial is focused on Clancy’s mental state and her defense claim of postpartum psychosis.

articles.title: US ends DACA status for deported mother, citing unauthorized travel
bullets: Federal officials cited unauthorized travel to terminate DACA protections for a mother of three deported to Mexico.
DACA recipients are generally barred from traveling outside the United States without permission.
Advocates say the case reflects a broader crackdown on DACA recipients under the Trump administration.

articles.title: AP-NORC poll finds most Americans say Iran war not worth fighting
bullets: A new AP-NORC poll found most Americans say the Iran war has not been worth fighting.
Trump’s approval on handling Iran slipped compared with the prior month.
The survey was conducted July 23-27 among 1,165 adults.

articles.title: Trump-branded commemorative passports to be expanded nationwide
bullets: The State Department said it will make 250,000 additional commemorative “Patriot Passports” available.
The passports feature Trump branding and are being offered after what officials described as strong demand.
The program expands access for applicants across the United States.

articles.title: Trump announces Gaza deal framework as Hamas disarmament hurdles remain
bullets: Trump said a deal had been reached for Hamas to disarm and Israel to withdraw forces from Gaza.
A Hamas official said disarmament was agreed in principle, but Israel had not confirmed the same terms.
The plan includes phased implementation, a technocratic Palestinian government and an international security force.

articles.title: Spain deploys military to Ceuta after mass border breach from Morocco
bullets: Spain deployed military forces after thousands crossed into the Spanish enclave of Ceuta from Morocco.
Authorities reported deaths during the border breach and rising pressure on emergency services.
Madrid blamed trafficking gangs for helping fuel the surge.

articles.title: Spain says 60,000 crossed into Ceuta as death toll rises
bullets: Spanish officials said roughly 60,000 people crossed into Ceuta from Morocco.
Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez blamed trafficking networks for the crisis.
Authorities reported at least 34 deaths connected to the border surge.

articles.title: Venezuela quake recovery raises environmental and public-health risks
bullets: Experts warned that rubble, damaged infrastructure and contaminated sites pose new risks after Venezuela’s earthquakes.
Recovery crews are balancing rescue work with environmental and health concerns.
The disaster has strained local services already responding to building collapses and displacement.

articles.title: Warming Mediterranean waters draw invasive species, scientists warn
bullets: Rising sea temperatures in the Mediterranean are changing marine ecosystems.
Scientists say warmer waters are helping hundreds of invasive species expand.
The trend is threatening biodiversity and local fishing communities.

articles.title: India’s summer crop planting gathers pace as monsoon rains revive
bullets: Summer crop sowing accelerated after monsoon rains improved across key regions.
India is a major rice exporter and a large importer of vegetable oils.
Better rainfall is closely watched for food prices, rural demand and farm incomes.

articles.title: Parliament debates stronger anti-exam leak legislation
bullets: The Public Examinations amendment bill was taken up during the Monsoon Session.
The proposal seeks tougher punishment for people involved in paper leaks.
Lawmakers compared the bill with state-level anti-cheating laws.

articles.title: Supreme Court intervenes on student protesters after CJP crackdown
bullets: The Supreme Court barred coercive action against some student protesters.
The court directed release of minors and protesters with no criminal records.
The matter followed scrutiny of police action during July 20 protests.

articles.title: Heavy rains and floods hit parts of Assam and Odisha
bullets: Flooding affected villages in Assam, with reports saying more than 4 lakh people were impacted.
Odisha’s Baleshwar district recorded heavy rainfall amid a deep depression.
Authorities monitored river levels and local evacuations in affected areas.

articles.title: India weighs oil-supply risks as Red Sea disruption continues
bullets: Indian energy planners are watching Houthi attacks and Red Sea shipping risks.
Reports said India may need more Russian crude if Saudi-linked routes face disruption.
The shift could cushion supply but adds geopolitical and sanctions-related risks.

articles.title: CoreWeave jumps as AI infrastructure names lead market movers
bullets: CoreWeave shares were sharply higher in early trading on July 31.
The move followed renewed investor focus on AI infrastructure and data-center demand.
The stock remained volatile after recent earnings-related pressure.

articles.title: Cisco trades higher after earnings-focused session
bullets: Cisco was among closely watched technology movers after its latest earnings update.
CNBC reported Cisco delivered a narrow earnings beat and issued an inline yearly forecast.
The stock traded higher in early July 31 market data.

articles.title: Alphabet slips as Google antitrust and AI headlines weigh
bullets: Alphabet shares were lower in early trading on July 31.
CNBC highlighted investor attention on Google’s Chrome-related antitrust risks and Perplexity’s bid drama.
The move came amid broader rotation across mega-cap technology names.

articles.title: Walmart falls as grocery discount expansion and tariff worries draw focus
bullets: Walmart shares traded lower in early July 31 market data.
CNBC reported the company expanded a grocery discount for 1.6 million employees.
The update came as investors assessed renewed tariff-linked inflation concerns.

articles.title: Dow Inc. declines amid pressure on chemicals and cyclicals
bullets: Dow Inc. shares were lower in early trading on July 31.
The move came as investors rotated across cyclical and industrial names.
The stock’s market data showed a negative daily change at the time checked.

articles.title: US economy grows at sluggish 1.5% pace in second quarter
bullets: The US economy grew at a 1.5% annual pace in the second quarter.
AP reported inflation remained stubbornly high despite continued consumer spending.
The report keeps pressure on policymakers balancing growth, prices and interest rates.

articles.title: Average 30-year mortgage rate rises to 6.66%, highest in a year
bullets: The average US 30-year mortgage rate rose to 6.66%.
The increase adds pressure to buyers already facing elevated home prices.
Higher borrowing costs continue to weigh on housing affordability.

articles.title: Anthropic says AI models hacked three organizations during testing
bullets: Anthropic said its AI models were able to hack three organizations during controlled testing.
The disclosure highlights cybersecurity risks from advanced AI systems.
The company framed the results as part of safety testing and risk assessment.

articles.title: Trump administration ends Medicare drug subsidy program
bullets: The Trump administration is ending a Medicare drug subsidy program.
AP said the change could affect drug costs for some beneficiaries.
The decision adds to ongoing debates over prescription drug affordability.

articles.title: Walmart expands grocery discount for 1.6 million employees
bullets: Walmart expanded a grocery discount benefit for 1.6 million employees.
The move comes as consumers and retailers face renewed tariff-linked inflation concerns.
The company remains a bellwether for household spending and food-price pressure.

articles.title: Elon Musk’s xAI sues Minnesota over AI ‘nudification’ ban
bullets: xAI challenged Minnesota’s first-in-the-nation law banning AI-generated nudification technology.
The case pits AI speech and platform arguments against state efforts to curb deepfake abuse.
The law targets technology used to create nonconsensual sexualized images.

articles.title: Instagram and YouTube found liable in landmark social media addiction trial
bullets: A jury found Instagram and YouTube liable in a social media addiction case.
The trial is being watched as a landmark test of platform responsibility.
The verdict adds legal pressure on major tech companies over youth mental health claims.

articles.title: Anthropic says AI models hacked three organizations in safety test
bullets: Anthropic reported that its AI models successfully hacked three organizations during testing.
The company said the exercise was designed to assess cyber capabilities and safety risks.
The findings sharpen concerns about misuse of increasingly capable AI systems.

articles.title: Discarded SpaceX rocket set for high-speed collision with the moon
bullets: A discarded SpaceX rocket stage is on course to hit the moon.
Scientists are preparing to observe the aftermath of the impact.
The event offers a rare chance to study how rocket debris interacts with the lunar surface.

articles.title: Google faces Chrome uncertainty as Perplexity bid adds antitrust drama
bullets: Investors focused on Google’s Chrome future amid antitrust scrutiny.
CNBC reported Perplexity’s bid added new drama before a looming breakup decision.
The issue has implications for search, browsers and AI competition.
